text: I usually wake up at six-thirty in the morning. After getting out of bed, I drink a glass of water and do a few simple stretches to wake up my body. Then I have a light breakfast, like toast with eggs and a cup of coffee, while I check the news on my phone. My work schedule is quite regular: I start at nine and finish at five. I spend most of the day at my desk, but I take a short walk during my lunch break. In the evening, I go for a run or do some yoga for about thirty minutes. After that, I cook dinner and relax by reading or watching a show. I try to be in bed by eleven. This routine works well because it is simple and consistent, helping me feel organized and energized every day.
